response.note: Assumes risk declines are attempts whose failure_category is 'risk' (exact label not verified against data), over Oct 22-31, 2026 (the last 10 days), excluding attempts without a card BIN.
response.sql: SELECT card_bin, COUNT(*) AS risk_decline_count FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND failure_category = 'risk' AND card_bin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY card_bin ORDER BY risk_decline_count DESC LIMIT 50
